npcs.name: Mira Ashkettle
npcs.description: Familiar face at the Hearth & Barrel; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Mira Ashkettle keeps the Hearth & Barrel running with the stubborn patience of a 42-year-old Halfling who has already survived worse seasons than this one. She polishes a dented copper mug between orders, and the chalk tally board behind the bar is usually within reach when tempers rise. Married to Bren; employs Pippa and Hound Garrik. Her private aim is plain enough: buy the empty lot next door for a beer garden. Still, she flinches at the thought of debt collectors spooking her evening crowd. Lately the trouble under her nose is this: A bloodstained cloak left on stool seven holds a noble signet in the hem.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; polishes a dented copper mug between orders.
npcs.motivation: Protect her place at the Hearth & Barrel long enough to buy the empty lot next door for a beer garden.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies that a bloodstained cloak left on stool seven holds a noble signet in the hem.
npcs.rumor: Mira can open doors at the Hearth & Barrel after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Measured halfling cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn halfling garb; chalk tally board behind the bar always nearby.

relationships.note: Trains and protects Pippa on busy nights.

npcs.name: Bren Ashkettle
npcs.description: Familiar face at the tavern cellar; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Walk into the tavern cellar and you will find Bren Ashkettle before you find a free chair. A 44-year-old Halfling cellar master, Bren greets trouble the way other folk greet weather: with a coat and a plan. He sniffs every bung before he trusts it. The ring of cellar keys worn shiny travels with him almost everywhere. Mira's spouse and cellar master. His ambition is to retire the smoky old boil kettle for a proper brew setup. His nightmare is contraband in his casks ruining Mira's name. Right now, Two casks bear burned smuggler marks under the wax he only found at midnight.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; sniffs every bung before he trusts it.
npcs.motivation: Protect his place at the tavern cellar long enough to retire the smoky old boil kettle for a proper brew setup.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies that two casks bear burned smuggler marks under the wax he only found at midnight.
npcs.rumor: Bren can open doors at the tavern cellar after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Measured halfling cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn halfling garb; ring of cellar keys worn shiny always nearby.

npcs.name: Pippa Reed
npcs.description: Familiar face at the busy taproom floor; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Pippa Reed keeps the busy taproom floor running with the stubborn patience of a 19-year-old Human who has already survived worse seasons than this one. She hums while she stacks tankards too fast, and the ribbon from her sister tied on her wrist is usually within reach when tempers rise. Employee of Mira; sweet on Tomas Reedpike. Her private aim is plain enough: save enough to apprentice with a seamstress. Still, she flinches at the thought of being sent back to the mill if she breaks too many mugs. Lately the trouble under her nose is this: She overheard Cal Drownwick promise a 'soft job' to a cloaked stranger.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; hums while she stacks tankards too fast.
npcs.motivation: Protect her place at the busy taproom floor long enough to save enough to apprentice with a seamstress.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies that she overheard Cal Drownwick promise a 'soft job' to a cloaked stranger.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near the busy taproom floor on a night Pippa worked late.
npcs.voice: Measured human cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn human garb; ribbon from her sister tied on her wrist always nearby.

relationships.note: Trains and protects Pippa on busy nights.
Blushes whenever Tomas comes off duty.

npcs.name: Hound Garrik
npcs.description: Familiar face at the tavern doorway; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Hound Garrik's reputation as a bouncer was built one careful errand at a time around the tavern doorway. Age 36 sits lightly on this Half-Orc, except when old debts creak. Watch long enough and you will see that he counts exits before he counts customers. The notched oak club hung by the coat pegs is part tool, part talisman. Mira's bouncer; once served under Serra's predecessor. He would trade sleep to earn a quiet room upstairs and a steady wage forever, yet stays wary of hurting someone who didn't deserve it in a brawl. Current spark: Recognized a wanted tattoo on a 'merchant' who fled when met his eyes.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; counts exits before he counts customers.
npcs.motivation: Protect his place at the tavern doorway long enough to earn a quiet room upstairs and a steady wage forever.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies that recognized a wanted tattoo on a 'merchant' who fled when met his eyes.
npcs.rumor: The notched oak club hung by the coat pegs once belonged to a person who vanished upriver.
npcs.voice: Measured half-orc cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn half-orc garb; notched oak club hung by the coat pegs always nearby.

npcs.name: Old Tallow
npcs.description: A fireplace regular rooted at the fireside bench, known for how he taps the hearthstones when a story turns true.
npcs.biography: Before dawn touches the roofs, Old is already at the fireside bench, working as a fireplace regular with flour, ink, sweat, or steel still on his fingers from yesterday. The habit everyone notices is simple: he taps the hearthstones when a story turns true. Close by sits his prized pipe carved like a sleeping hound, a small anchor in a loud town. Retired carter; friend to Nell and Jab. He wants to see the Midsummer fair one more year. He fears dying with his best stories untold more than open confrontation. A usable adventure hook trails him: Swears he saw lanterns moving under the old mill three nights running.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; taps the hearthstones when a story turns true.
npcs.motivation: To see the Midsummer fair one more year without feeding dying with his best stories untold.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than he admits: Swears he saw lanterns moving under the old mill three nights running.
npcs.rumor: Old is writing a private list of debts the council will not touch.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A human silhouette framed by the fireside bench, hands seldom empty of the pipe carved like a sleeping hound.

npcs.name: Sela Vintner
npcs.description: The wine seller people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: Sela Vintner keeps the wine corner of the tavern running with the stubborn patience of a 31-year-old Half-Elf who has already survived worse seasons than this one. She rolls corks between her fingers while she listens, and the travel-stained sample case of rare vintages is usually within reach when tempers rise. Supplies Mira; trades rumors with Jor Sandline. Her private aim is plain enough: open a tasting room with Mira next spring. Still, she flinches at the thought of her upriver supplier being replaced by smugglers. Lately the trouble under her nose is this: A bottle she sold as orchard white tasted of river silt and iron.
npcs.personality: Soft-spoken until principles are poked; rolls corks between her fingers while she listens.
npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to open a tasting room with Mira next spring.
npcs.secret: Night thoughts keep returning to her upriver supplier being replaced by smugglers, especially since: A bottle she sold as orchard white tasted of river silt and iron.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near the wine corner of the tavern on a night Sela worked late.
npcs.voice: Quick river-town diction, then sudden silences that mean more than words.
npcs.appearance: Easy to spot near the wine corner of the tavern: half-elf, practical layers, and that travel-stained sample case of rare vintages.

npcs.name: Jory Mugwright
npcs.description: A taproom cook rooted at the tavern kitchen, known for how he tastes stew with the same wooden spoon for luck.
npcs.biography: Some townsfolk swear Jory was born mid-shift at the tavern kitchen; the truth is only slightly less devoted. This Dwarf taproom cook, now 88, treats competence like courtesy. He tastes stew with the same wooden spoon for luck, never far from the spice box with a false bottom for salt pork money. Cook for Mira; buys barrels from Cooper Brenwick. Ask what he wants and he names it plainly: publish a chapbook of 'proper dwarf stews for soft southern mouths'. Ask what he dreads and the answer is the roof leaking into his flour again. Then comes the fresh problem—Found a coded note pinned under a delivery crate of turnips.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; tastes stew with the same wooden spoon for luck.
npcs.motivation: To publish a chapbook of 'proper dwarf stews for soft southern mouths' without feeding the roof leaking into his flour again.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than he admits: Found a coded note pinned under a delivery crate of turnips.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near the tavern kitchen on a night Jory worked late.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A dwarf silhouette framed by the tavern kitchen, hands seldom empty of the spice box with a false bottom for salt pork money.

npcs.name: Nessa Brightcup
npcs.description: Familiar face at the tavern stage plank; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Before dawn touches the roofs, Nessa is already at the tavern stage plank, working as a evening singer with flour, ink, sweat, or steel still on her fingers from yesterday. The habit everyone notices is simple: she tunes her lute to the room's mood before she smiles. Close by sits her prized songbook with pages swapped for maps, a small anchor in a loud town. Performs at Mira's; shares rooms sometimes with Rilo. She wants to earn a noble patronage without losing the common room. She fears a past patron recognizing her from another town's scandal more than open confrontation. A usable adventure hook trails her: Her new ballad names a 'pale clerk' who sells signatures by moonlight.

npcs.voice: Measured gnome cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn gnome garb; songbook with pages swapped for maps always nearby.

npcs.name: Cal Drownwick
npcs.description: The dice dealer people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: Cal Drownwick keeps the corner dice table running with the stubborn patience of a 27-year-old Human who has already survived worse seasons than this one. He laughs one beat late when the dice betray him, and the weighted knucklebone die he never uses in his own tavern is usually within reach when tempers rise. Debtor to Marrow; acquaintance of Rook. His private aim is plain enough: win one clean stake large enough to leave town smiling. Still, he flinches at the thought of Marrow Cline collecting more than coin. Lately the trouble under his nose is this: Steered a drunk grain merchant toward Rook Vell for a cut.

npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to win one clean stake large enough to leave town smiling.
